/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/0/items.source_en: Seoraksan is the farthest stop (2.5 hr drive each way) so it's visited first while energy is freshest, with Nami and Morning Calm sequenced on the natural return route through the Chuncheon-Gapyeong corridor — no backtracking.

The day moves from highest energy (Seoraksan stairs and optional cable car) to medium (Nami's flat walking circuit) to lowest (Morning Calm's relaxed garden stroll). Photo style progresses from granite ridge → tree-lined lanes → curated botanical compositions.

From December 5 - March 15, the Morning Calm 17:00 arrival catches the daytime garden plus the Lighting Festival ignition — 200,000+ LEDs across the 330,000 m² grounds, a single-ticket value most independent travelers can't time as cleanly.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: Nami Island ferry (₩19,000) and Morning Calm garden (₩11,000) are bundled into the tour price — no per-stop tickets needed. Only the optional Seorak Cable Car (₩16,000 round-trip) is on-site own-expense.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.tm: Deux points de prise en charge dans Séoul

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/1/items.source_en: Hongik (Mapo-gu) at 06:00 and ⟦G0⟧ (Jung-gu) at 06:30 cover Seoul's two main accommodation clusters — guests choose the exit closest to their hotel.
All three stops are predominantly outdoor; the coach is the only indoor segment. Works well in moderate weather; heavy rain shifts cable car off the menu but everything else remains visitable.

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.source_en: Seoraksan has stairs (cable car is optional)
/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.tm: Le Seoraksan comporte des escaliers (le téléphérique est facultatif)

/whyTourWorks/routeLogicSections/2/items.source_en: The Sinheungsa Temple level and the optional Heundeulbawi loop both have stairs. The Tongildaebul + Sinheungsa walk is flat and accessible; the cable car ascent is by chair lift (no stairs in cable car itself), but Gwongeumseong platform has rocky steps at the top.
Cable car is not bookable in advance

Seorak Cable Car tickets are on-site only and can queue 1-2 hours in October peak. If skies are foggy or queues are long, the recommended alternative is the Biseondae streamside walk (flat, paved, ~90 min round trip) which fits the same 3-hour budget.

This is a coach group tour — 13 hours total including ~4.5 hours of coach time. Guests wanting fewer hours or unlimited stop time should consider our private chartered car day trip (door-of-hotel pickup, customizable timing).

/routeShapeIntro/title.tm: Comment se déroule cette journée au départ de Séoul

/routeShapeIntro/subtitle.source_en: Early Hongik/⟦G0⟧ pickup at 06:00/06:30; ~2.5 hr northeast drive to Seoraksan for the day's mountain anchor; back through the Inje-Chuncheon corridor for Nami Island's tree-lined ferry circuit; 30-min south to Morning Calm for the day's gentlest closing chapter (lighting-festival ignition in winter); return to Seoul by 19:00-19:30.
